close_reason: Fixed in same commit as JMAP-tjvm.1 — both are the same shape, .1 (email_get) and .2 (email_parse) share crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs. Sweep covered 6 sites across 3 client crates (mail/calendars/filenode); see bd:JMAP-tjvm.1 close comment for full detail.
description:
Same shape as bd:JMAP-tjvm.1 but in src/methods/email.rs:314-325 for
`email_parse`. The serialized EmailParseParams is iterate-merged into args
AFTER the typed accountId/blobIds are set, so caller-controlled
`params.extra` can silently clobber the wire arguments computed from the
bound session and the typed `blob_ids` slice.

Trigger: caller puts `{"accountId": "victim"}` (or `"blobIds"`, `"properties"`)
into params.extra. The `Email/parse` request goes out with the wrong account
or blob set.

Fix: same as the email_get case — set typed fields after the merge or filter
reserved keys.
title: email_parse: EmailParseParams.extra can override accountId/blobIds
